newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks revived by weak yen, bank buy-backs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks revived by weak yen, bank buy-backs.

text.p: Tokyo stocks revived on Tuesday after buy-backs of bank shares resumed and a weaker yen encouraged investors seeking high-technology blue-chip issues, brokers said.
But trade was listless as there was little to steer the market apart from currencices, they said.
The 225-share Nikkei average ended the day up 135.65 points or 0.74 percent at 18,564.78. Its March futures finished up 160 points at 18,580.
"Bank issues were back on their feet today and most high-tech issues as well, sustaining the gains in the indices throughout the day," said a strategist at a second-tier brokerage.
